title: Nazareth
lead: A small village in the hills of Lower Galilee where Jesus grew up. It is never named in the Old Testament, Josephus or the Mishnah. Julius Africanus (about AD 220, quoted by Eusebius, Church History 1.7.14) mentions "Nazara" as a village of Jesus' relatives; the earliest Jewish mention is a synagogue inscription from Caesarea listing priestly families, from about AD 300.
